data.name: Seal A Driveway [RELEASE 🛢️]
data.description:
🛢️ SEAL A DRIVEWAY 🛢️

Grab a pail, pour the sealer, and drag the squeegee until every last
inch of asphalt goes glossy black. Get paid. Do it again, even bigger.

🏘️ Work the neighbourhood, then open the Estate District and the
   Megamart retail park
🧹 Real coverage — every stroke counts and missed patches show
🚛 Buy your own rig: Bantam Dart ➡️ Kerbline 160 ➡️ Longline 280 ➡️
   Cistern Heavy
⚙️ Upgrade bucket capacity, pour speed, refill speed, squeegee length
   and walk speed
🔁 Rebirth for permanent cash multipliers — and pay the toll to unlock
   the next district
⭐ Daily rewards, quests, and global leaderboards: Top Earners, Most
   Rebirths, Most Jobs
💤 Park up in the AFK Yard and keep earning while you're away

Sealed is sealed. 🖤

👍 LIKE & ⭐ FAVOURITE for new districts and trucks!
